newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Aug 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Aug 11.

text.p: These are significant stories in the Ivorian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Government daily salutes President Diouf of Senegal who arrives for four-day state visit on Monday. In interview, he speaks of progress towards regional integration in West Africa, says underdevelopment is not inevitable.

- Opposition newspaper concentrates on large public meeting on Sunday by veteran opposition leader Laurent Gbagbo and his Ivorian Popular Front (FPI). Gbabgo said constitutional changes announced at weekend not enough to guarantee equitable elections.

- Agreement to allow Canadian oil company Ranger to join operating consortium for CI-26 offshore block ends dispute between Ivorian government and Addax, company originally designated as operator, which had been unable to find partner agreeable to government.
